theorems.name: A Coupon Bond in the Vasicek Model Is Worth the Sum of Its Affine Bond Prices
theorems.description: In the Vasicek model, with the integrated short rate R(t) = M(t) + sigma * (Wiener integral of the integrated kernel) from r0 (kappa > 0) and the discount factor D(t) = exp(-R(t)), the schedule paying c_i at t_i (i < n), valued under D as a contract in any model, is worth sum_i A(t_i) exp(-B(t_i) r0) c_i, with A, B the Vasicek affine coefficients. The Brownian measure is read as the pricing measure; no change of measure is built. No integrability hypothesis is needed.

import MathFin.Contracts.Models.ShortRate

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open scoped NNReal
open MathFin MathFin.Contracts

/-- A coupon bond in the Vasicek model is worth the sum of its affine bond prices. -/
theorem valueDisc_coupon_bond_vasicek {ι Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : Measure Ω}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ} (hB : IsPreBrownianReal B μ) (r₀ θ σ : ℝ)
    {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 0 < κ) (X : ι → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (t : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (c : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    (fixedFlows t c n : Contract ι).valueDisc μ
        (shortRateDiscount (vasicekIntegratedRate hB r₀ θ σ hκ)) X
      = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,
          vasicekBondA θ σ κ (t i) * Real.exp (-(vasicekBondB κ (t i) * r₀)) * c i :=
  valueDisc_fixedFlows_vasicek hB r₀ θ σ hκ X t c n

theorems.name: A Coupon Bond in the Two-Piece GSR Model Is Worth the Sum of Its Gaussian Bond Prices
theorems.description: In the Gaussian short-rate model with mean reversion kappa > 0 and volatility sigma1 before a switch time T* and sigma2 after, with the integrated short rate R(t) in its Wiener representation from r0 and the discount factor D(t) = exp(-R(t)), the schedule paying c_i at dates t_i >= T* (i < n), valued under D as a contract in any model, is worth sum_i exp(-M(t_i) + V(t_i)/2) c_i, with M the Vasicek integrated mean and V = gsrBondV the GSR variance. The Brownian measure is read as the pricing measure. Payment dates before T* are not covered.

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open scoped NNReal
open MathFin MathFin.Contracts

/-- A coupon bond in the two-piece GSR model is worth the sum of its Gaussian bond prices. -/
theorem valueDisc_coupon_bond_gsr {ι Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : Measure Ω}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ} (hB : IsPreBrownianReal B μ) (r₀ θ σ1 σ2 : ℝ)
    {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 0 < κ) (Tstar : ℝ≥0) (X : ι → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (t : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (c : ℕ → ℝ)
    (n : ℕ) (ht : ∀ i < n, Tstar ≤ t i) :
    (fixedFlows t c n : Contract ι).valueDisc μ
        (shortRateDiscount (gsrIntegratedRate hB r₀ θ σ1 σ2 hκ Tstar)) X
      = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, Real.exp (-(vasicekIntegratedMean r₀ θ κ (t i))
          + gsrBondV κ σ1 σ2 (Tstar : ℝ) (t i) / 2) * c i :=
  valueDisc_fixedFlows_gsr hB r₀ θ σ1 σ2 hκ Tstar X t c n ht
